title: Documentation link and wording pass across the factory docs
summary: A repository-wide editorial pass over the documentation set. It replaces bare references to decision records with relative Markdown links, rewrites vague deictic phrases ("today", "above", "the table below", "Stage 1") into self-contained wording, and expands a few terse passages into explicit tables or named stages. Two Rust test doc-comments lose their stale "Change N:" prefixes. No runtime behaviour, schema or interface changes: the only code touched is comment text in `crates/osf/src/hook.rs` and `crates/osf/tests/skill_lint.rs`.
